en.name: Favicon Generator
en.short: Generate favicon.ico, Apple and PWA icons, the manifest and the tags from one image.
en.title: Favicon generator: ICO, apple-touch-icon, PWA and manifest
en.description: Upload a logo and get every icon a modern site needs: favicon.ico (16, 32, 48), favicon.svg, apple-touch-icon 180, PWA icons 192 and 512 plus a maskable one, the site.webmanifest and the link tags. Download everything as a ZIP. Your image never leaves your browser.
en.lead: One image in, the complete set of icons and the HTML tags out.
en.chooseHint: SVG or a square PNG of at least 512px works best.
en.name: App name
en.hint: Choose or drop an image to generate the icons.
en.unreadable: This image could not be read.
